results.test_desc: Ensure that the etcd data directory ownership is set to etcd:etcd (Automated)
results.remediation: On the etcd server node, get the etcd data directory and run chown etcd:etcd.
test_info: On the etcd server node, get the etcd data directory.

results.test_desc: Ensure that the API server pod specification file permissions are set to 600 or more restrictive (Automated)
results.expected_result: permissions has permission 600, expected 600 or more restrictive

results.test_desc: Ensure that the cluster has at least one active policy control mechanism in place (Manual)
results.remediation:
Ensure that either Pod Security Admission or an external policy control system is in place
for every namespace which contains user workloads.
results.reason: Test marked as a manual test

results.test_desc: Minimize the admission of privileged containers (Manual)
results.remediation:
Add policies to each namespace in the cluster which has user workloads to restrict the
admission of privileged containers.
results.reason: Test marked as a manual test

results.test_desc: Minimize the admission of containers wishing to share the host process ID namespace (Automated)
results.remediation:
Add policies to each namespace in the cluster which has user workloads to restrict the
admission of `hostPID` containers.
results.reason: Test marked as a manual test

results.test_desc: Minimize the admission of containers wishing to share the host IPC namespace (Automated)
results.remediation:
Add policies to each namespace in the cluster which has user workloads to restrict the
admission of `hostIPC` containers.
results.reason: Test marked as a manual test

results.test_desc: Minimize the admission of containers wishing to share the host network namespace (Automated)
results.remediation:
Add policies to each namespace in the cluster which has user workloads to restrict the
admission of `hostNetwork` containers.
results.reason: Test marked as a manual test

results.test_desc: Minimize the admission of containers with allowPrivilegeEscalation (Automated)
results.remediation:
Add policies to each namespace in the cluster which has user workloads to restrict the
admission of containers with `.spec.allowPrivilegeEscalation` set to `true`.
results.reason: Test marked as a manual test

results.test_desc: Minimize the admission of root containers (Automated)
results.remediation:
Create a policy for each namespace in the cluster, ensuring that either `MustRunAsNonRoot`
or `MustRunAs` with the range of UIDs not including 0, is set.
results.reason: Test marked as a manual test
